item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Soham folds the square sheet in the figure once down the middle, punches one hole through both layers, then unfolds the sheet.

Which claim correctly predicts the unfolded design?

options.A: The fold line itself is the punched design.
options.B: One hole appears anywhere on the paper, even where the layers did not meet.
options.C: Two holes appear as mirror images across the fold line, because the fold forced matching positions to coincide.
options.D: The punched holes are what create the fold line.
